c64_demo_dutchbreeze.en: This is a demo, not a game: it loads and then plays by itself, with nothing to control. It runs from side 1 of the original multi-side release and will ask for the next side when it reaches that point — the Download button gives the complete set. Loading is slower here than for the games on this shelf, on purpose: demos use their own custom disk loaders, so the Vault switches true 1541 drive emulation on for them instead of the fast virtual-device load.
